_comment: EDIT THIS FILE to change who gets alerts. 'emailRecipients' get ALL alert emails (handover + errors) via the Apps Script. 'staff' entries are matched by topic for handover alerts — a staff member with topics ['sales'] is alerted for sales handovers; use ['*'] to receive everything. telegramChatId / callmebotPhone+callmebotApiKey are OPTIONAL per person and only used if the matching channel is enabled below AND the corresponding tokens are set in the environment (.env).
